{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Full corrected test suite

# R01: basic put/get with tags
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
assert c.get('a') == 1

# R01: deep copy
c.put('b', {'nested': [1,2]}, ['y'])
val = c.get('b')
val['nested'].append(3)
assert c.get('b') == {'nested': [1,2]}

# R01: string rejected as tags
try:
    c.put('k', 'v', 'tag')
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# R01: non-string tag rejected
try:
    c.put('k', 'v', [1])
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# R02: invalidate
c2 = TaggedCache(3)
c2.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c2.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
c2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert c2.invalidate('x') == 2
assert len(c2) == 1

# R02: replacement removes old tags
c3 = TaggedCache(2)
c3.put('a', 1, ['old'])
c3.put('a', 2, ['new'])
assert c3.invalidate('old') == 0
assert c3.get('a') == 2

# R03: maxsize validation
try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(0)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# R04: invalidate_many union
cc = TaggedCache(5)
cc.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
cc.put('c', 3, ['y','z'])
assert cc.invalidate_many(['x','z']) == 3
assert len(cc) == 0

# R04: mode='all'
cc2 = TaggedCache(5)
cc2.put('a', 1, ['x','y'])
cc2.put('b', 2, ['x'])
cc2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert cc2.invalidate_many(['x','y'], mode='all') == 1
assert len(cc2) == 2

# R05: resize
cc3 = TaggedCache(3)
cc3.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc3.put('b', 2, ['x'])
cc3.put('c', 3, ['x'])
_ = cc3.get('b')
cc3.resize(2)
assert len(cc3) == 2
assert 'a' not in cc3._cache
assert 'b' in cc3._cache
assert 'c' in cc3._cache
assert cc3.maxsize == 2

# R06: generator tags
cc4 = TaggedCache(2)
cc4.put('k', 'v', (t for t in ['a','b']))
assert cc4.get('k') == 'v'
assert cc4.invalidate('a') == 1

# R07: TTL - at exact boundary key IS expired
clock = [0]
c5 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c5.put('a', 1, ttl=2)
assert c5.get('a') == 1  # timer=0, expiry=2
clock[0] = 1  # 1 < 2, not expired
assert c5.get('a') == 1
clock[0] = 2  # 2 >= 2, EXACTLY at boundary = expired
try:
    c5.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# TTL zero immediately expired
c6 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c6.put('a', 1, ttl=0)
try:
    c6.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# Invalid TTL values
for bad in [-1, float('inf'), float('nan'), True, False]:
    try:
        c6.put('b', 1, ttl=bad)
        assert False, f'ttl={bad} should have raised'
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Invalid mode
try:
    c6.invalidate_many(['x'], mode='invalid')
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Empty tags removes nothing
assert c6.invalidate_many([]) == 0
assert c6.invalidate_many([], mode='all') == 0

# R08: expired entries removed before get, put, len, resize, invalidation
clock = [0]
c7 = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c7.put('a', 1, ttl=2, tags=['x'])
c7.put('b', 2, ttl=2, tags=['y'])
c7.put('c', 3, ttl=2, tags=['z'])
clock[0] = 3
assert len(c7) == 0
assert c7.invalidate('x') == 0
assert c7.invalidate('y') == 0
assert c7.invalidate('z') == 0

# Putting into expired cache
c7.put('d', 4, tags=['w'])
assert len(c7) == 1

# resize on expired cache
c7.resize(2)
assert c7.maxsize == 2

# Overwriting replaces expiry
clock = [0]
c8 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c8.put('a', 1, ttl=2, tags=['x'])
clock[0] = 3
c8.put('a', 2, ttl=10, tags=['y'])
assert c8.get('a') == 2
clock[0] = 4
assert c8.get('a') == 2
clock[0] = 13
try:
    c8.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# resize with TTL-expired entries
clock = [0]
cc10 = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: clock[0])
cc10.put('a', 1, ttl=10, tags=['x'])
cc10.put('b', 2, ttl=10, tags=['y'])
cc10.put('c', 3, ttl=10, tags=['z'])
clock[0] = 11  # all expired
assert len(cc10) == 0
cc10.resize(2)
assert len(cc10) == 0  # all expired, nothing to keep

# resize growing
clock = [0]
cc11 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
cc11.put('a', 1, tags=['x'])
cc11.put('b', 2, tags=['y'])
cc11.resize(5)
assert len(cc11) == 2
assert cc11.maxsize == 5

# Failed resize preserves state
cc12 = TaggedCache(3)
cc12.put('a', 1, tags=['x'])
try:
    cc12.resize(0)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
assert len(cc12) == 1
assert cc12.maxsize == 3

# Deduplicate tags
cc13 = TaggedCache(2)
cc13.put('a', 1, tags=['x','x','x'])
assert cc13.invalidate('x') == 1
assert len(cc13) == 0

# LRU eviction doesn't leave stale memberships
clock = [0]
cc14 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
cc14.put('a', 1, tags=['x'])  # LRU
cc14.put('b', 2, tags=['x'])  # MRU
# Now cache is full, both with tag 'x'
# Access 'a' to update recency: a becomes MRU, b becomes LRU
_ = cc14.get('a')
# Now put 'c' - should evict 'b' (LRU)
cc14.put('c', 3, tags=['y'])
assert len(cc14) == 2
assert 'b' not in cc14._cache
assert 'a' in cc14._cache
assert 'c' in cc14._cache
assert cc14.invalidate('x') == 1  # only 'a' has 'x' now
assert len(cc14) == 1
assert 'c' in cc14._cache

print('All manual tests passed!')
"
"}
